question: Can one shared logit-time slope plus ridge-shrunk entity intercepts beat both frozen P057 baselines without sacrificing calibration in the partial-completeness stratum?

data_contract.candidate_training_pool: all frozen public source rows for the fitted indicator whose year is in the permitted training window, including entities without a 2023 target
data_contract.evaluation_rows: the exact ordered 141 indicator-entity rows frozen by P057_AMR_baseline_eval_v1

candidate.model: one unpenalized intercept and one unpenalized shared calendar-time slope plus one ridge-penalized intercept deviation per observed entity, fitted separately for each indicator
candidate.prediction_for_entity_absent_from_a_fold: global intercept plus shared slope; entity deviation equals zero

hyperparameter_selection.method: rolling-origin validation using training-period outcomes only
hyperparameter_selection.selection_metric: equal-row mean absolute error in percentage points pooled across every validation row in all four folds
hyperparameter_selection.selection_granularity: one lambda selected independently per indicator

frozen_gate.primary: candidate equal-entity weighted absolute error must be strictly lower than both locf and country_logit on every required slice
frozen_gate.calibration: candidate absolute calibration bias must be no more than 2.0 percentage points above the lower of the two frozen baseline absolute biases on every required slice
frozen_gate.failure_action: reject this candidate specification without post-hoc cohort changes or retuning
frozen_gate.pass_action: label only as a provisional candidate-screen pass and require replay on an untouched future year or data vintage

controls.constant_series: a synthetic constant-percent panel must reproduce the constant 2023 percentage within 1e-10 percentage points
controls.exact_unpenalized_shared_slope: with zero ridge penalty, a synthetic exact shared-logit-slope panel must recover every 2023 percentage within 1e-10 percentage points

confirmation_boundary.holdout_exposure: The 2023 outcomes were already summarized in the published baseline evaluation before this candidate protocol was frozen.
confirmation_boundary.required_next_confirmation: an untouched future year or data vintage not used to choose, motivate, or report this candidate

interpretation_boundaries: This is a forecasting-method screen over aggregate public rates, not a clinical or causal study.
The evaluation remains conditional on the 141 entities with a 2023 observation and at least three training observations.
No patient, prescribing, treatment, pathogen-manipulation, or public-health intervention recommendation is permitted.
A gate pass does not solve catalog problem #057 and does not establish performance on non-reporting entities.
